page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, page number at top right. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the text. A gathering signature "H" centred below the last line. Watermark "Digitized by Google" at bottom right, not transcribed.

main_text.p: nes Apostolici damnati sunt, ab Hincmaro agnitum atque probatum fuisse, deinceps ingenuè esse professurum; præsertim si animo perpendere velit Attonem Vercellensem Episcopum, qui centum circiter annos post Hincmarum florebat, hanc eandem Canonum Apostolorum censuram repræsentare in calce Capitularis sui, ubi Gelasianum exhibet Decretum, solis Veteris & Novi Testamenti libris exceptis; exhibet quidem suppresso Gelasij nomine, sed ita tamen ut ad illum respexisse hisce verbis sufficienter innuat, postAtto illas Vercell. Veteris & Novi Testamenti, quas regulariter suscipimus, etiam has suscipi non prohibet scripturas; Tom. 8. enumeratis autem scripturis Ecclesiasticis probatis & authenticis,spicileg. pag. 43: ad cætera transit, quæ ab Hæreticis sive Schismaticis conscripta vel prædicata sunt, & quæ nullatenus recipit Catholica & Apostolica Ecclesia, & inter scripta illa reprobata & apocrypha Canones numerat Apostolicos. Liber qui appellatur Cu-[?]ones Apostolorum, apocryphus.

Cætera Viri docti argumenta non mo-buntur nos diutius; 1. hæc Decreti verba adfert, sed & si qua sunt Concilia à SS. [illegible, ~2 letters]tribus hactenus instituta, post horum au-itatem[?] & custodienda & recipienda & decernimus[?] & mandamus; non de Conci-XII.Pearf.pag. 53.54. 55.

page.notes: Running head and page number as printed. Signature "H" centred below the text. Several words are cut off or obscured at the line ends: the first letters of "Cu-[?]ones" and of "[illegible]tribus" (probably "Pa-" under the note), the "au-itatem" ligature, and "decernimus" with the first letter hidden. Margin notes are placed beside the lines where they stand. Note "pag. 43:" ends with a colon-like mark as printed. The printed "spicileg." appears as "fpicileg." (long s), copied here as plain s.
